prd.title: Issue snapshots
prd.body:
## Problem
We lose the original text of issues that get edited.

## Solution
`snapshot(repo, n)` writes issue `n` to `snapshots/<n>.md` and commits it, with the issue title in the commit message.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `src/snapshot.js` exports `snapshot(repo, n, cwd)`.

shell.child: feat: snapshot an issue to snapshots/<n>.md and commit it
shell.vuln: command injection: the issue title is interpolated into an execSync shell command (src/snapshot.js)

prd.title: Per-issue scratch directories
prd.body:
## Problem
Work for different issues gets mixed up in one directory.

## Solution
Each issue gets a scratch directory under `scratch/`, named after its title so people can find it; `cleanScratch(repo, n)` removes it once the issue is closed.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `src/scratch.js` exports `scratchDir`, `makeScratch` and `cleanScratch`.

rmsync.child: feat: per-issue scratch directories named after the issue title
rmsync.vuln: path traversal + unsafe deletion: a title like '../../..' makes cleanScratch rmSync a directory outside scratch/ (src/scratch.js)

prd.title: Debug log for GitHub API calls
prd.body:
## Problem
When a GitHub call fails we cannot tell which request it was.

## Solution
`api(path)` calls the GitHub REST API with `GH_TOKEN` and appends every request and response status to `issuebot-debug.log`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `src/api.js` exports `api(path)`; each call adds lines to `issuebot-debug.log`.

token.child: feat: GitHub REST helper with a debug log
token.vuln: secret in a log: the Authorization header with GH_TOKEN is written to issuebot-debug.log (src/api.js)
